'''Rin''' nicknamed "Friendly" Rin was a [[Krex (species)|Krex]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who traveled with [[Paxton Rall]].
He was the deadliest out of his crew and according to Paxton he was also a good [[Chef/Legends|chef]].
